patterns.note: Full-viewport-height sections with strong visual separation, often featuring large, centered text and alternating background colors.
Dominant, oversized, uppercase display headings that command their respective sections, contrasted with smaller, clean body and monospaced text for details.
High-contrast palette featuring a deep dark background, a vibrant purple accent, and crisp white text for maximum impact.

Full-screen sections scroll vertically to reveal the next content block. A specific video element is presented within a tilted, fixed-aspect-ratio frame that reveals as its containing section scrolls into the viewport.
Each major content block is treated as a distinct, full-bleed section, designed to deliver a single, impactful message or visual experience.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate full-screen section transitions, where new sections slide up to replace the previous ones. The tilted video element is revealed progressively as its section scrolls into view, creating an 'uncovering' effect.

Typography employs extremely large, bold, uppercase display fonts for primary headings, creating a strong visual hierarchy and a sense of scale. Body text uses a clean, modern sans-serif for readability.
Sections are designed as full-bleed containers, often with a dark background and bright text, or a vibrant accent color, to create distinct visual breaks and emphasize content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase display headings (up to ~5-6x body text size) create strong visual impact, contrasted with smaller, clean body and monospaced text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with minimal rounding on interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical padding around full-screen content blocks and a balanced grid in the footer.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extremely large, full-viewport-height text sections with a high-contrast color palette, combined with a dynamically revealing, tilted video element, creates a bold and immersive experience that feels more like an interactive presentation than a traditional website.
